original.identity: recoil opens the side-fruit approach; a broad upper shore and a different lower root exit remain visible

play_contract.alternative: Ordinary held-jump/H or recoil-only strategies remain legal and must be compared with the intended RH.
play_contract.counterexample: Verify the raised fruit is truly capturable from the real launch. A recorded R then H without useful contact does not pass.
play_contract.decision: Create the higher approach with an early recoil, then catch the fruit; after landing choose the upper continuation or the lower outer root.
play_contract.observe: The side fruit is above the direct ground ray; the wide receiving branch is visible on its far side.
play_contract.recovery: Failure falls to the same broad root; one outside root lip restores the departure without an added ladder.
